name: github_list_pull_requests
description: List pull requests in a repository. Returns an array of {number, title, state, user, head, base, draft, ...}. Provide `owner`, `repo`; optional `state` ('open' default, 'closed', 'all') and `per_page` (max 100, default 30).

state.description: Filter by PR state. Defaults to 'open'.
